regions.name: Amazon
regions.quote: This species occurs throughout the upper Amazon region with records existing from various tributary drainages in Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, and Peru including the Solimões, Purus, Japurá/Caquetá, Juruá, Putumayo/Içá, Napo, Itaya, Ampiyacu, Ucayali, Marañón and Huallaga.
